# App setup and effects

From [the component index](../components.md). A prop with `?` is optional, and `= x` is its default. An indented line is the shape of a value the prop takes. In the examples, `children`, `transactions`, the icons and the handlers stand for the screen's own content, data and state.

## LinkProvider

```tsx
import { LinkProvider } from "@tuja/ui/components/link-provider";
```

Once at the root, so every `Button` with an `href` uses the router's link (`RouterLink` from `@tuja/next-links/router-link` in a Next app).

Props (also `css`):

- `children: ReactNode` — The part of the app that uses this link, usually the whole app.
- `linkComponent: LinkSlot` — The link every `Button` with an `href` below it renders, usually a framework link such as `next/link`.

## EffectLayerProvider

```tsx
import { EffectLayerProvider } from "@tuja/ui/components/effect-layer-provider";
```

Once at the root of an app that draws WebGPU effects, such as the liquid of a `Switch`.

Props (also `css`):

- `children: ReactNode` — The page, rendered under the effect layer's `<canvas>` elements.

## PortalTargetProvider

```tsx
import { PortalTargetProvider } from "@tuja/ui/components/portal-target-provider";
```

Once at the root: the box that overlays such as `Sheet` and `Popover` portal into.

Props (also `css`):

- `children: ReactNode`

## BlurPlaneProvider

```tsx
import { BlurPlaneProvider } from "@tuja/ui/components/blur-plane-provider";
```

Around a shell whose floating controls blur the page under them.

Props (also `css`):

- `children: ReactNode` — The shell's content, rendered inside the provider so every floating control under it can paint its blur onto the page's Blur plane.

## ProgressiveBlur

```tsx
import { ProgressiveBlur } from "@tuja/ui/components/progressive-blur";
```

The page blurred around a floating element, in place of dimming it.

Props (also `css`):

- `children?: ReactNode` — The floating element the blur radiates from; several children are measured as one, less any with no box at this breakpoint.
- `radius?: number = 16` — Nominal blur radius in px at the strongest point, against the floating element.
- `isShown?: boolean = true` — Whether the blur is shown.
- `reach?: number` — How far the blur reaches past the floating element, in px, on every side.
- `isOnPlane?: boolean = true` — Whether the blur belongs on the page's Blur plane.

## FixedContainerContent

```tsx
import { FixedContainerContent } from "@tuja/ui/components/fixed-container-content";
```

Around fixed content that flashes in Chrome during a view transition.

Props (also `css`):

- `children: ReactNode` — Content to isolate on its own compositing layer.
- `ref?: Ref<HTMLDivElement>` — Ref to the layer wrapper element.

## EffectCarrier, EffectContainer

```tsx
import { EffectCarrier } from "@tuja/ui/components/effect-carrier";
import { EffectContainer } from "@tuja/ui/components/effect-container";
```

Say what the effects inside move with, or keep them inside one container.

### EffectCarrier

Props (also `css`):

- `children: ReactNode` — The content. Each effect hook in it, at any depth, draws its effects on this Effect carrier, also when its element is portalled out, until an `EffectCarrier` inside declares another.
- `value: "viewport" | "viewport-bottom" | "contained" | EffectSticky | ScrollRegionRef` — What the content moves with.
  - `EffectSticky { ref: RefCallback<Element>; isStuck: boolean; css: StyleProp; carrier: EffectCarrierRef }`
  - `ScrollRegionRef { scroller: RefCallback<Element>; content: RefCallback<Element>; carrier: EffectCarrierRef }`

### EffectContainer

Props (also `css`):

- `children: ReactNode` — The content of the container.
- `value: EffectContainerRef` — The ref from `useEffectContainer`, attached to the container element.

## useRipple, useLiquid, useDust, useExtractorFan, useLightBeam, useBlackHole

```tsx
import { useRipple } from "@tuja/ui/hooks/use-ripple";
import { useLiquid } from "@tuja/ui/hooks/use-liquid";
import { useDust } from "@tuja/ui/hooks/use-dust";
import { useExtractorFan } from "@tuja/ui/hooks/use-extractor-fan";
import { useLightBeam } from "@tuja/ui/hooks/use-light-beam";
import { useBlackHole } from "@tuja/ui/hooks/use-black-hole";
```

Effect-layer hooks: attach the returned ref to an element. Read the `effect-layer` skill first.

### useRipple

Options (also `css`):

- `ambient?: boolean = false` — Also pulse on a slow beat while on screen, as well as on hover, press and focus.

### useLiquid

Options (also `css`):

- `position: number` — Where the thumb rests, as a share of the track's travel: 0 at the off end, 1 at the on end, 0.5 in the middle for indeterminate.
- `drag?: number | null = null` — Where a drag holds the thumb, as a share of the travel, or `null` while no drag is on.
- `pressed?: boolean = false` — A pointer is down on the control.

### useDust

Options (also `css`):

- `density?: number = 3` — How much dust the element sheds: particles a second along every 100 px of its edge.
- `burst?: number = 0` — How much dust the element shakes off at once each time it is clicked, also by the keyboard: particles along every 100 px of its edge, at most 256.
- `shakes?: number = 0` — A count of the bursts the element shakes off without a click.
- `carrier?: "viewport"` — Where the dust goes once shed.

### useExtractorFan

Options (also `css`):

- `reach?: number = 400` — How far from its edge the element pulls dust in, in CSS px.
- `strength?: number = 1` — How fast the element pulls dust in, as a multiple of the usual speed, such as 2 for dust that must arrive from far away in a short time.

### useLightBeam

Options (also `css`):

- `angle?: number` — Where the beam points while the pointer does not aim it, as a CSS angle: 0 points up and 90 points right, as in `linear-gradient`.
- `followsPointer?: boolean = true` — Turns the beam towards the pointer while the pointer is over the page or a finger touches it, on a spring.

### useBlackHole

Options (also `css`):

- `mass?: number = 1` — How strongly it bends light, as a multiple of the mass its size gives it.
